name: J. S. Alexander
role: Partner in the Pyramid Park hotel (Boyd & Alexander)
mentions: Since the reopening of the Pyramid Park hotel, Little Missouri, by Boyd & Alexander, they are enjoying the large patronage, which they deserve, as the house from parlor to kitchen is first class. Their advertisement appears in another column.
